entities.summary: Ea-mukin-zēri, inscribed mdÉ-a-mu-kin-NUMUN, son of Hašmar, was the 2nd king of the 2nd Sealand or 5th Dynasty of Babylon, c. 1004 BC, but only for 3 months, according to the Dynastic Chronicle, 5 months according to the Kinglist A.
